_comment: Multi-level engine validation (ADR 0006). Spawn player adjacent to level_1 goal; moving N triggers contact rule → transition_level → level_2 loads with player position preserved. Asserts: (1) level transitions, (2) persistent player survives, (3) level-scoped entities (walls, goal) get cleared and reloaded.

scenarios.name: level_transition_loads_next_level
scenarios._: Place player at (0, 0, 7) — 1m south of level_1's goal at (0, 0, 8). After ~5 ticks, contact rule fires, transition_level → level_2, world.current_level becomes 'level_2'.

scenarios.name: level_2_walls_replace_level_1_walls
scenarios._: After transition to level_2, the player should see level_2's walls (e.g. wall_l2_block_n at (0,0,4)) — NOT level_1's walls (e.g. wall_l1_w which had id 'wall_l1_w'). After 50 ticks (level_1 cleared, level_2 loaded), level_1 wall ids are gone.

scenarios.name: player_state_persists_across_levels
scenarios._: Set player.cleared=42 before level transition; after level swap, player.cleared should still be 42 (well, +1 from goal_reached effect = 43 actually — but the persistent tag means it didn't reset to 0). Tests the persistent-tag path.
